functions.name: organization_invitations
functions.description: Canonical current organization invitations selected by team or explicit pending/failed organization population; accepted and canceled invitation history is not enumerated. Pending organization invitations selected through one team. Identity is organization/invitation, so retrieving the same invitation via another team does not create a distinct business entity. Invitee login and email may be NULL; invitation role is an organization invitation role, not a team membership role.

metrics.name: organization_invitation_count
metrics.comment: Selected organization_invitations rows at their declared qualified grain.
